findings.message: beforeSwapReturnDelta can bypass concentrated-liquidity swap math and create a no-op swap.
findings.remediation: Prove all four swap quadrants, backing, partial fills, slippage and zero-sum settlement with specialist review.

findings.message: The declared signature model intentionally accepts only a fixed EOA signer and does not support ERC-1271 contract-wallet validation.
findings.remediation: Review signer provenance, custody, environment isolation, rotation and revocation, key-loss recovery, low-s enforcement and incident response before candidate approval.

findings.message: Project category dynamic-fee-hook is not a closed launch-type decision and requires architecture review of its declared behavior.
findings.remediation: Keep the category and describe the actors, value flows, authorities, failures and integration surfaces; do not force the project into an unrelated known profile.

findings.message: Chain 1301 is eligible for public application review, but the current Programmable launch runtime is integrated only with Ethereum Mainnet (chain 1).
findings.remediation: Continue the application and architecture review without making a launch claim; a separate maintainer-owned chain integration and release must pass before Programmable can launch this project on the target chain.

findings.message: The prototype does not yet bind both the public project and token logo resources.
findings.remediation: A logo may remain pending during prototype work, but bind its URI, exact bytes, mutability and owner before provider or launch presentation.

findings.message: Shared custom accounting carries correlated exposure even with PoolId-scoped liabilities.
findings.remediation: Prefer one hook instance per pool and retain cross-pool solvency invariants if sharing is required.

findings.message: Chain 1301 is application-eligible, but this standard has no committed chain profile for it.
findings.remediation: Keep the canonical network slug and add exact Uniswap v4 deployments, Cancun and EIP-1153 support, PoolManager, router, Permit2, runtime, source and pinned-fork evidence for architecture review.
